sections.heading: Black Hat Conference Overview
paragraphs: Black Hat is a prominent cybersecurity conference that attracts professionals and companies from around the world. It is known for its focus on cutting-edge security research and trends.

sections.heading: AWS Preview
paragraphs: According to Amazon Web Services (AWS), the Black Hat 2026 conference will feature a preview of enterprise security at machine speed, showcasing the latest advancements in the field.

sections.heading: Cybersecurity Companies to Watch
paragraphs: Investing.com and Security Boulevard have both highlighted a list of 12 cybersecurity companies to watch at Black Hat USA 2026. These companies are expected to make significant contributions to the industry and are poised for growth.

faq.q: Why is Black Hat trending in Italy?
faq.a: The interest in Black Hat in Italy is likely due to the conference's focus on cybersecurity, which is a growing concern for businesses and individuals. The spotlight on innovative companies and technologies at the conference has caught the attention of Italian security professionals and enthusiasts.
